chapter_title: Export Oriented Units (EOUs), Electronics Hardware Technology Parks (EHTPs), Software Technology Parks (STPs) and Bio-Technology
title: Monitoring of NFE

business_rules.rule_description:
6.12 Monitoring of NFE
Performance of EOUs shall be monitored by Units Approval Committee as per
guidelines given in Appendix 6F of Appendices & ANFs.
